entry.summary: 吴说获悉，根据 DefiLlama 数据，MakerDAO（现改名为 Sky） 上有两个濒临清算的 ETH 大额仓位，清算价分别为 $1786（约 1.15 亿美元）和 $1805（约 1.09 亿美元）。值得注意的是，由于 MakerDAO 采用预言机安全模块（OSM），即便市场价格短时间跌破这些清算点，这些仓位也并不会马上进入清算，因为系统收集多个授权喂价机的数据，通过 Medianizer 合约计算中位数作为参考价格（而非市场即时价格），并延时约 1 小时再应用，以防止短时波动被利用。据了解，前者仓位在 3 月 11 日的大跌中险些遭受清算，由于独特的价格预言机机制，通过即时还款和增加抵押品以脱离清算风险；后者仓位近 5 个月都无相关操作。http://wublock123.com/index.php?m=content&c=index&a=show&catid=6&id=40194

entry.title: RT Pix🔎: Xyzeva just saved crypto. Again. She found a flaw that could’ve hacked Coinbase engineers and top crypto teams through a massive auto-upd...
entry.summary: RT Pix🔎 Xyzeva just saved crypto. Again. She found a flaw that could’ve hacked Coinbase engineers and top crypto teams through a massive auto-update exploit. Millions of users were at risk. Billions in assets on the line. She reported it. It got patched. Crypto was saved. Her reward? Just $55K. But this isn’t even her first time. She also exposed a16z leaking AWS keys, database credentials, and PII—sitting in inspect element. That hack could’ve compromised one of the biggest VCs in crypto. Her reward? $0. Then, she discovered a way to hijack someone’s Arc browser without them even visiting a website — letting attackers execute arbitrary JavaScript on any page. That time, she got $2K. $57K total for stopping multiple disasters. Some people break crypto. Xyzeva keeps saving it.
